ops.title: hostregistry: ErrStateSchema tells users to 'manually recreate exact schema v1 state' but InitializeState never repairs and no tooling exists
ops.description:
The exact-envelope hard cut (d8dde6a "feat(state): hard-cut exact schema v1") shipped with no migration path, no documentation, and an error message that actively misleads: `ErrStateSchema = "state.json schema mismatch; manually recreate exact schema v1 state"` (hostregistry/state.go:25) — but InitializeState's write branch fires only when the file is ABSENT ("An existing file must already satisfy the exact contract and is never repaired", state.go:69-91), no --force/--reset/--recreate flag exists, no code path moves or backs up the old file, and the CHANGELOG has no entry for the cut. 434c652 deleted the legacy-mesh migration tooling on the assumption every host had converged; two production hosts had not.

Field impact (2026-07-25/26 stabilization): both fleet machines were wedged — synckit reconcile failed every 15-min spawn for days on the box; reposync (which shares this hostregistry code as its product namespace) was 100% CLI-wedged on yasyf-home, since parsing happens on every command. Working remedies discovered empirically and recorded on daemonkit cc-notes task fc39f885: synckit state = cp backup + mv aside + `synckitd host add <peer> --no-recurse --self <self>` (re-derives the mesh); reposync state = lossless envelope wrap (fingerprint-gated jq, artifacts referenced in reposync bug c4127dc).

Suggested shape: teach InitializeState (or the callers) an explicit recreate flow — back up the old file, write the fresh envelope, and for product namespaces attempt a lossless payload lift where the payload is shape-identical (reposync's was byte-for-byte). At minimum, the error should name the move-aside procedure.

ops.text: a supported migration or state-recreate path exists for a pre-envelope state.json (flag, subcommand, or automatic move-aside-and-rebuild)
the schema-mismatch error names the actual remedy instead of 'manually recreate'
the hard-cut envelope change is documented (CHANGELOG + upgrade note) for every product namespace sharing hostregistry
